# Don Aurelius Sovereign Syndicate
> Institutional Autonomous AI Quantitative Trading Intelligence & Genesis Suite

## Overview
Don Aurelius is an institutional quantitative trading intelligence and autonomous multi-agent matrix engineered specifically for spot Gold (XAUUSD) execution on MetaTrader 5. Engineered and architected by Founder & Chief Strategic AI Architect SM.KANISH.

## Primary Inventions (The Genesis Suite)
- **Project Eagle-Eye**: Multimodal Computer Vision AI candlestick pattern scanner. Renders charts in real-time, executing visual neural inference on liquidity zones, fair value gaps, and institutional order blocks.
- **Project Quantum Twin**: 1,000-path Monte Carlo jump-diffusion 4-hour path simulation engine. Runs Merton jump-diffusion models to compute empirical mathematical probabilities and risk surfaces before order execution.
- **Project Global Sentinel**: Geopolitical Crisis Radar & Safe-Haven Spread Shield. Analyzes macro news feeds, central bank policy announcements, and intermarket co-integration (DXY EUR/USD proxy and US 10-Year Treasury Yields) to veto trades during high-volatility structural shifts.
- **Project Jarvis Co-Pilot**: Full-duplex neural voice synthesis (ElevenLabs / Edge Neural TTS) and interactive Telegram command matrix. Enables bidirectional tactical briefings, real-time audio telemetry, and remote risk governance.

## Multi-Agent War Room Consensus Architecture
Trading decisions require a 3/4 supermajority consensus among 4 autonomous quantitative agents:
1. **HAWK**: Trend velocity & structural order flow specialist.
2. **RADAR**: Macro intermarket & interbank sentiment analyst.
3. **PREDATOR**: Deep liquidity hunter & institutional footprint tracker.
4. **INQUISITOR**: Adversarial devil's advocate that aggressively seeks reasons to veto high-risk setups.
